text.p: - Alexander Lebed's image of truthseeker and peacemaker is incompatible with the image of a former Kremlin plotter, the daily says, referring to his new alliance with former presidential bodyguard Alexander Korzhakov.
- The former head of the National Sports Fund, Boris Fyodorov, does not want to leave the political scene and has resurfaced to discredit Korzhakov.
- The government is considering the possibility of reducing budget spending by lifting a number of tax privileges and budget credits.
- The main function of the commission on extreme economic measures, set up to improve tax collection, will be to frighten those who have different opinions on Russia's economic development.
- Russian politicians are considering the idea of creating favourable economic conditions for Chechnya, avoiding defining its political status.

- The struggle for power in Russia has been turned into a sort of national sport -- compromatball -- because of all the compromising material which opponents are threatening to reveal about each other to gain favour with the president. The Watergate scandal is nothing compared to the current noisy quarrels among Russian politicians.
